props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when the form's `defaultValues` doesn't supply one.

props.name: description
props.description: Description rendered between the label and the control. Overridden by the `description` slot.

props.name: error
props.description:
Manual error override. When provided, takes precedence over the
validator-derived error from the surrounding `<VyForm>`.

props.name: help
props.description: Helper text rendered below the control. Hidden when an error is showing.

props.name: hint
props.description: Small auxiliary text rendered next to the label (right-aligned). Overridden by the `hint` slot.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text rendered above the control. Overridden by the `label` slot.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name — must be unique within the parent `<VyForm>`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required — appends a red asterisk to the label.

props.name: validators
props.description: Synchronous validators (see `@vyui/core`). Stops at the first error.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { value: unknown; error: string | null; setValue: (value: unknown) => void; disabled: boolean; }
